newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Carlstadt, N.Y..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Carlstadt, N.Y..

text.p: SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Chief Financial Officer of the Borough of Carlstadt, in the County of Bergen, New Jersey (the

Municipal Building, 500 Madison Street, Carlstadt, New Jersey 07072 on until 11:00 o'clock a.m. Prevailing Time at which time they will be publicly opened and announced, for the purchase of the Borough's $2,000,000 Tax Appeal Refunding Bonds dated March 1, 1997 (the Bonds'') and payable on March 1 in each year as follows:

$500,000 in each of the years 1998 to 2001, inclusive. The Bonds shall be issued in registered form by means of a book-entry system with no physical distribution of bond certificates made to the public. One bond certificate for each maturity will be issued to The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York (DTC'') and immobilized in its custody. The book-entry system will evidence ownership of the Bonds in the principal amount of $1,000 or any multiple thereof, with transfers of ownership effected on the records of DTC and its participants pursuant to rules and procedures established by DTC and its participants. This Summary Notice of Sale is intended only as a brief summary of the Notice of Sale (the Notice of Sale''), which Notice of Sale is

hereby incorporated herein by this reference thereto. The Notice of Sale and Proposal for Bonds should be reviewed by potential bidders for additional terms and conditions of the sale of the Bonds prior to bidding on the Bonds.

The Bonds will bear interest from their date at a single rate of interest in a multiple of 1/8th or 1/20th of 1% per annum specified by the successful bidder payable on each March 1 and September 1, commencing September 1, 1997, in each year until maturity. The purchase price specified must not be less than $2,000,000 nor more than $2,001,000. Bidders must at the time of making their bids deposit a certified, cashier's or treasurer's check in the amount of $40,000 drawn upon a bank or trust company to the order of the Borough. The Bonds will be sold to the bidder specifying the lowest rate of interest in accordance with the terms set forth in the Notice of Sale. The Borough will furnish the Bonds and the approving legal opinion of LeBoeuf, Lamb, Greene & MacRae, Newark, New Jersey, Bond Counsel.
The Bonds will be designated as
obligations'' for purposes of Section 265(b)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended.
Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement, the Notice of Sale and the Proposal for Bonds are available by
contacting the undersigned Chief Financial Officer at Memorial Municipal Building, 500 Madison Street, Carlstadt, New Jersey 07072 (telephone (201) 939-2890).
By order of the Borough Council of the Borough of Carlstadt.
